meta.name: vercel-deploy
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use this skill when the user requests deployment actions such as "Deploy my app", "Deploy this to production", "Create a preview deployment", "Deploy and give me the link", or "Push this live". No authentication required - returns preview URL and claimable deployment link.

howto.what: 部署时,Claude 会把项目打包(排除 node_modules 和 .git)、自动识别框架(如 Next.js、Nuxt 等)并上传到 Vercel,无需登录,完成后返回预览链接和认领链接。
howto.when: 当你说“部署我的应用”“部署到生产环境”“创建预览部署”等部署请求时触发。

howto.what_en: On deployment, Claude packages the project (excluding node_modules and .git), auto-detects the framework (e.g. Next.js, Nuxt), uploads to Vercel without requiring login, and returns preview and claim URLs.
